propositions.name: aether_deformation_double_refraction
propositions.statement: Deformation of matter when moving through the aether might be accompanied by a sensible double refraction.
propositions.quote: It occurred to me that such a deformation of matter when moving through the rather might be accompanied by a sensible double refraction

propositions.name: michelson_morley_negative_result
propositions.statement: The Michelson-Morley experiment gave a negative result in which interference takes place between two rays, one travelling to and fro in the direction of the earth's motion and the other to and fro in a perpendicular direction.
propositions.quote: well-known negative result of the Michelson-Morley experiment in which interference takes place between two rays, one travelling to and fro in the direction of the earth's motion, and the other to and fro in a perpendicular direction

propositions.name: aether_shares_earth_motion
propositions.statement: The negative result is most naturally interpreted as proving that the aether in the laboratory shares the earth's motion.
propositions.quote: is most naturally interpreted as proving that the aether in the laboratory shares the earth's motion

propositions.name: aberration_favours_stationary_aether
propositions.statement: Stellar aberration favours the opposite theory of a stationary aether.
propositions.quote: other phenomena, especially stellar aberration, favour the opposite theory of a stationary aether

propositions.name: fitzgerald_lorentz_contraction
propositions.statement: Solid bodies, such as the stone platform of Michelson's apparatus, alter their relative dimensions when rotated in such a way as to compensate the optical change that might naturally be looked for.
propositions.quote: solid bodies, such as the stone platform of Michelson's apparatus, alter their relative dimensions, when rotated, in such a way as to compensate the optical change that might naturally be looked for

propositions.name: double_refraction_delicately_testable
propositions.statement: The beginning of double refraction can be tested with extraordinary delicacy.
propositions.quote: the beginning of double refraction can be tested with extraordinary delicacy

propositions.name: liquids_show_no_expected_double_refraction
propositions.statement: There is no double refraction in liquids of the order to be expected, comparable with the single refraction.
propositions.quote: the conclusion may be stated that there is no double refraction of the order to be expected, that is comparable with 10 of the single refraction

propositions.name: kerr_electric_double_refraction
propositions.statement: The liquid condition is no obstacle to the development of double refraction under electric stress.
propositions.quote: the liquid condition is no obstacle to the development of double refraction under electric stress, as is shown in Dr. Kerr's experiments

propositions.name: light_polarized_by_nicol
propositions.statement: Light was polarized by the first nicol in a plane inclined to the horizontal at 45 degrees.
propositions.quote: was polarized by the first nicol in a plane inclined to the horizontal at 45°

propositions.name: parallel_transverse_vibration_hypothesis
propositions.statement: Luminous vibrations parallel to the earth's motion might be propagated a little differently from those whose direction is transverse to the earth's motion.
propositions.quote: luminous vibrations parallel to the earth's motion, i. e. east and west, are propagated a little differently from those whose direction is transverse to the earth's motion

propositions.name: transverse_orientation_eliminates_double_refraction
propositions.statement: When both directions of vibration for light passing the tube are transverse to the earth's motion, no double refraction could manifest itself.
propositions.quote: both directions of vibration for light passing the tube are transverse to the earth's motion, and therefore no double refraction could manifest itself

propositions.name: rotation_180_no_effect
propositions.statement: No effect is to be expected from a rotation through 180 degrees.
propositions.quote: In no case is any effect to be expected from a rotation through 180°

propositions.name: effect_second_order_velocity_ratio
propositions.statement: Such effect as a rotation through 90 degrees may entail must be of the second order in the ratio which expresses the velocity of the earth relatively to that of light.
propositions.quote: such effect as a rotation through 90° may entail must be of the second order in the ratio which expresses the velocity of the earth relatively to that of light

propositions.name: earth_orbital_and_solar_motion
propositions.statement: According to the theory of a stationary aether, we have to do with the motion of the earth in its orbit and also with the motion of the sun in space.
propositions.quote: we have to do not only with the motion of the earth in its orbit, but also with that of the sun in space

propositions.name: sun_motion_toward_hercules
propositions.statement: The motion of the sun is supposed to be much the smaller and to lie directed towards the constellation Hercules.
propositions.quote: The latter is supposed to be much the smaller, and to lie directed towards the constellation Hercules

propositions.name: april_motions_conspire
propositions.statement: In the month of April, when successful experiments were first made, the two motions would approximately conspire.
propositions.quote: In the month of April, when successful experiments were first made, the two motions would approximately conspire

propositions.name: strained_glass_produces_double_refraction
propositions.statement: The strained condition of the glass produces just such a double refraction as might be caused by the motion of the liquid through the aether.
propositions.quote: the strained condition of the glass produces just such a double refraction as might be caused by the motion of the liquid through the aether

propositions.name: no_band_shift_observed
propositions.statement: In neither case could the slightest shift of the band be seen on rotation of the board from the north-south position to the east-west position, whether at noon or at 6 p.m.
propositions.quote: In neither case could the slightest shift of the band be seen on rotation of the board from the north-south position to the east-west position, whether at noon or at 6 p.m.

propositions.name: earth_magnetism_rotates_polarization
propositions.statement: In consequence of the earth's magnetism there must be a rotation of the plane of polarization when the light traverses the bisulphide of carbon in the north and south position.
propositions.quote: In consequence of the earth's magnetism there must be a rotation of the plane of polarization when the light traverses the bisulphide of carbon in the north and south position

propositions.name: magnetic_rotation_constant
propositions.statement: For one C.G.S. unit of magnetic potential the rotation in bisulphide of carbon at 18 degrees is .042 minute of angle.
propositions.quote: For one C.G.S. unit of magnetic potential the rotation in CS 2 at 18° is .042 minute of angle

propositions.name: small_rotation_below_observation_limit
propositions.statement: A rotation of the plane, which would show itself by a fading and not by a displacement of the band, is below the limit of observation.
propositions.quote: which would show itself, if at all, by a fading and not by a displacement of the band, is below the limit of observation

propositions.name: nicol_rotation_revived_light_law
propositions.statement: If theta be the angle of rotation of the nicol, the revived light is sin squared theta, expressed as a fraction of the maximum obtainable with parallel nicols.
propositions.quote: If θ be this angle, the revived light is sin²θ, expressed as a fraction of the maximum obtainable with parallel nicols

propositions.name: retardation_phase_revival_law
propositions.statement: A retardation of phase epsilon gives a revival of light measured by sin squared of half epsilon.
propositions.quote: a retardation of phase ε, in place of π, gives a revival of light measured by sin²(½ε)

propositions.name: strip_double_refraction_matches_tested_character
propositions.statement: The double refraction due to the loads on the strip is of exactly the character to be tested for.
propositions.quote: The double refraction due to the loads is of exactly the character to be tested for, and accordingly this method affords a very direct check

propositions.name: load_effect_independent_length_inverse_width
propositions.statement: If the load be given, the effect is independent of the length of the strip and of its thickness along the line of vision, but is inversely as the width.
propositions.quote: If the load be given, the effect is independent of the length of the strip and of its thickness along the line of vision, but is inversely as the width

propositions.name: wertheim_load_retardation_relation
propositions.statement: A load of 10 kilograms per millimetre of width gives a relative retardation of half a wave-length.
propositions.quote: it requires a load of 10 kilograms per millimetre of width to give a relative retardation of ½λ

propositions.name: bisulphide_wavelength_count
propositions.statement: In the length of the bisulphide of carbon tube there are contained 1,200,000 wave-lengths of yellow light, or 2,400,000 half wave-lengths.
propositions.quote: In this length there are contained 1,200,000 wave-lengths of yellow light, or 2,400,000 half wave-lengths

propositions.name: detection_margin_sufficient
propositions.statement: The effect to be expected is of the order such that there is nearly 100 times to spare.
propositions.quote: The effect to be expected is of the order 10 , so that there is nearly 100 times to spare

propositions.name: solid_internal_strain_causes_double_refraction
propositions.statement: A sufficient thickness of glass in one piece is liable to exhibit too much double refraction from the effect of internal strains.
propositions.quote: A sufficient thickness in one piece is liable to exhibit too much double refraction from the effect of internal strains

propositions.name: no_double_refraction_in_solids
propositions.statement: Even in solids there is no double refraction, of the order to be expected, due to motion through the aether.
propositions.quote: enough remains to justify us in concluding that even here there is no double refraction (of the order to be expected) due to motion through the aether

propositions.name: delicacy_less_for_water
propositions.statement: With the water the delicacy of the test was somewhat less.
propositions.quote: With the water the delicacy of the test was somewhat less.

propositions.name: solid_test_loses_delicacy
propositions.statement: As compared with the observations upon liquid there was a loss of delicacy of four times when solid matter was used.
propositions.quote: so that as compared with the observations upon liquid there was a loss of delicacy of four times
